data.address: 2200 Cantrell Sansom Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76131

reviews.text: Puryear Custom Pools (PCP) from the get-go, listened to what we wanted and delivered where other companies designed what they wanted to instead.  Our goal was to add a pool/spa to our backyard and for it to be the centerpiece while the other companies wanted to add landscaping and throw a pool in.  We were under contract in December 2021 and by April 2022 we were filling with water.  We just completed our fourth summer with it and couldn't be happier with it and PCP. Review update at ONE YEAR OF OPEN POOL SEASON:
I have had a few problems with everything working properly, but not ONE time has Puryear failed to come out, and they continued to come back as many times as needed to find the problem.  They also take total accountability for all problems and correct them right away.  It took a while to find the problem, but they have handled it 100% without issue.  All warranty work, 100% not an issue.  Would recommend Puryear again and again!

Puryear Pools exceeded all my expectations.  The customer service given by the entire team was over the top for my third pool.  The sales and design we experienced with Alex was not only a joy but we feel we have gained a friend.  Our builder Scott was always on site and scheduled our project seamlessly along with fantastic and professional subs. They built my pool but the pool maintenance and cleaning is very bad. Here are some pictures to attest to that. I expected the owner to call and at least apologize or even better rectify the problem in a timely manner. When you pay more the 200 dollars monthly for a cleaning service and you get tossed from one secretary to the next over the phone, that’s not good customer service. You lost me as a client and lost future recommendations.

Sasha was sensitive to our needs when a piece of equipment was inoperable.  We scheduled service, but the service department was not able to complete the repair, having to schedule a third party to complete the work.  It was just over a month before the problem was fixed.

I wanted to give a 5 star review for our pool maintenance tech. Carlos has now been our guy for the last few months. He’s always on time and never misses a Thursday morning. Our pool has never looked better! He is a great kid and gives me hope for this generation of kids coming up. He stands out!!

Puryear Pools built us a pool completed in 2021 and since then have done our serive and maintenance. They are easy to work with and very responsive. I especially like the new texting feature with the service dept. We love our pool so much and would highly recommend Puryear Pools.

Again, they over sprayed the back of my house, cleaned the siding, all the windows, obviously dumped chemicals on my roof when they scrubbed it off. Brand new house. brand new roof. Not a trust worthy company. Yes, and three years later this is what it looks like. STAY AWAY. USE SOMEONE ELSE. Stay tuned. I'll be dumping more pics and videos soon. Thank you to Micki for running the show while our pool was constructed. Micki was an outstanding project manager and his communication skills are on point. I knew everything that was happening.

Thank you James for keeping our pool up to par and getting us started. I appreciate the tips you taught me and showing me how a salt system works.

We had a great experience with Puryear pools. We interviewed 10+ companies and decided on them for their team (amazing!), quality, attention to detail and scale. From our first contact and appointment with Brandon (our designer) we were off to an amazing start. No pressure, highly skilled and wanted what we wanted....our dream pool, part 2! Brandon's patience know no bounds. Thank you, Brandon. We had Scott as our PM - Thank you Scott for everything. Scott worked tirelessly with all the contacto

Puryear built our pool 9 years ago. Through all the years, their customer service has been top notch. We are now getting it refinished and are so pleased with them. Price and service. They have, once again, made it so easy for us. Nick was very helpful and knowledgeable! We will continue to have them handle any needs we have.

I’ve had this company for sometime now for my cleaning and they are so great. Customer Service , the people they hire, everyone is consistent. They have really taken the pool out of my worries and that is a lot for me.. recently Mike cleaned my pool and i’m leaving this review because I feel like he just did a little bit extra. Sparkling! Thank you so much!

Our experience with Puryear Pool was great! Our build was headache free! We were always told ahead of time, when they would be at our home, and what they would be doing. They cleaned up each day after they were there. They had to take a fence down to use their equipment, and they put it back up, and welded it, looking as good as new. They took care to avoid damaging our yard. We would definitely recommend Puryear Pool for anyone’s new pool build.

From planning to installation, the Puryear team has been outstanding! Great communications from start to finish. The construction teams were fast! they told me 60-90 days to finish and they got it done in about 45 days. All the teams we helpful when I had questions! Overall outstanding experience. Highly recommended!

We were given Mickey as a construction manager who went above and beyond for me!!! From re measuring things 5x and showing and explaining things to me every step of the way!

Recently completed a pool renovation with Puryear and w can't be more pleased with the result. The process started with the initial bid. This process was simple and easy. John was straight forward and trustworthy. His suggestions for our renovation was a welcome communication. Everything he recommended was right on point and we agreed. Other companies were asked to bid and received, the bids were confusing and contained many "what if's". This was not acceptable to us. John's bid was competitive

We absolutely love our pool built by Puryear Customer Pools earlier this year. We've owned a pool before, but had never built a pool before this year and so we really didn't know what to expect. There were 3 phases of the process, each with a designated point person to walk you through everything. Derek helped us with the design and he was awesome. Working with Puryear Pools, was not only satisfying personally but professionally. The design experience was completely to our liking, material selection, and planning all went seamlessly. The build was completely within the timeframe and the end result met all of our satisfaction and we were blown away with how well, all the contractors and subs worked to complete such a project in a seamless manner. We highly recommend anyone to visit and see what they can do for you.
